I have consistently had a shocking experience with this surgery. There is a complete lack of care and compassion for patients. The reception staff speak to us like 4 year olds every single time, in such a rude and patronising way - completely inappropriate in a healthcare setting. The eConsult system is utterly useless. Being told we’ll be contacted by the next day, yet no contact is received for three to four days. When contact does occur, it’s a generic email stating the request has been passed to the clinical team, followed by a further wait of several more days for any actual response. The entire process causes even further delays and patients suffering longer than necessary. Calling the surgery offers no meaningful support whatsoever. We’re told to submit yet another eConsult, repeating the same information and restarting the same delays. Face-to-face appointments are non existent with this surgery. On the rare occasions we’re lucky enough to get one (I’ve only ever had 3 in roughly the best part of 10 years!) you won’t be seen by a GP but by a clinician with a lower level of qualification. These consultations are yet again pointless as you’ll be asked “what would you like me to do then?”. 9 times out of 10, the outcome of contacting the surgery is being told to complete another eConsult, to go to A&E or call 111. This seriously raises concerns about the level of care being provided. I have experienced these same issues every single time I have needed to contact the surgery. The surgery has a consistent lack of kindness, compassion, and genuine concern for patients. They are a constant issue, leaving us as patients questioning what has happened to GP surgeries being supportive, caring, and truly patient-focused. I have never spoken to or met anyone who is registered here who’s had a positive experience or who hasn’t faced
